_comment: Generation patterns extracted from ttcn3_generation_sop.json for use as referenced rules by Core Agent and Infrastructure Agent. Each pattern includes: pattern_name, preconditions, template_code (TTCN-3 or C++), and example_substitutions.
_important_constraint: V2G application messages (SupportedAppProtocol through SessionStop) MUST be sent via structured union: pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ v2g := { msgType := md_CMN_MsgReq_001 } }). The C++ V2G_TCP_TLS_Port adapter intercepts the v2g variant, calls ExiCodecAdapter::encode() to look up pre-encoded wire_hex from exi_payload_library.json, patches SessionID if needed, and sends wire bytes over TCP. V2GTP Header BadCase tests ONLY (TC_SECC_CMN_VTB_V2GTPHeader_*): send raw octetstrings via pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ raw := '0201FD...'O }). MUST NOT use int2oct or raw octetstrings for V2G application messages.

patterns.description: SDP discovery via UDP multicast. Always position 1 in precondition_chain for V2GTP/SDP tests.
preconditions: Always position 1 (first) in precondition_chain

related_protocol_constants.sdp_response_payload: SDP Response with SECC IPv6 address

patterns.description: CORRECT way to send V2G application messages via the TCP port. The port out type is V2G_PortMessage, a dual union. Use the v2g variant to send structured V2G messages -- the C++ V2G_TCP_TLS_Port adapter intercepts the v2g variant, calls ExiCodecAdapter::encode() to look up pre-encoded wire_hex from exi_payload_library.json, patches SessionID if needed, and sends wire bytes over TCP.
preconditions: Port V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_{SUT}_Port must be mapped
V2G_MessageUnion type must be defined in Types_SECC_15118_2.ttcn
Template md_CMN_{Msg}Req_001 must be defined in SECC_CmnTemplates.ttcn
negative_constraints: MUST NOT use int2oct, '01'O, 'FE'O, '8001'O for V2GTP header construction in V2G app messages
MUST NOT send raw octetstrings to the TCP port for V2G application messages -- use { v2g := ... }
MUST NOT use openv2g encoder or X-Macro mapping -- ExiCodecAdapter handles it

patterns.description: TCP/TLS connection establishment. Used after SDP discovery to connect to discovered SECC.
preconditions: SDP discovery must have completed (position 1)
V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_Port must be mapped

patterns.description: V2GTP layer BadCase tests (TC_SECC_CMN_VTB_V2GTPHeader_*) MUST send raw V2GTP bytes via the TCP port's raw variant. This is the ONLY exception to the structured union rule. The { raw := ... } variant of V2G_PortMessage bypasses EXI encoding and V2GTP patching entirely -- the C++ adapter sends the exact bytes as-is. Use this for testing invalid ProtocolVersion, invalid InverseProtocolVersion, invalid PayloadType, or mismatched PayloadLength.
preconditions: Only for V2GTP layer tests (protocol_layer=V2GTP, tc_id contains V2GTPHeader)
TCP connection must already be established by InitConfiguration
For all other V2G application messages, use structured union { v2g := ... } instead

common_errors.error: Using structured union { v2g := ... } for V2GTP header tests
common_errors.fix: V2GTP header tests MUST use { raw := ... } to send raw bytes. The v2g variant triggers EXI encoding and adds V2GTP header with ProtocolVersion=0x01 -- you cannot override it.

common_errors.error: Sending { raw := ... } for V2G application messages (not V2GTP header tests)
common_errors.fix: { raw := ... } is only for V2GTP layer BadCase tests (TC_SECC_CMN_VTB_V2GTPHeader_*). For all V2G application messages, use { v2g := { msgType := ... } }.

patterns.description: Standard alt block with timer. Each non-timeout branch MUST stop the timer before setverdict.
preconditions: Timer must be started before the alt block
All port receive operations must be covered

common_errors.error: Timer not stopped in non-timeout branch
common_errors.fix: Always call tc_msg.stop before setverdict in every branch that does NOT timeout.
The timeout branch does NOT call stop -- the timer already expired.
Every send/receive/check operation on a port must have a corresponding alt branch.

patterns.description: Standard port map/unmap pattern for test case phases A and D.
preconditions: Ports must be defined in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn
Port instance names must match generation_plan

port_type_constraints.V2G_TCP_TLS_Port: type port V2G_TCP_TLS_Port message { out V2G_PortMessage; in V2G_MessageUnion; }
port_type_constraints.V2G_UDP_SDP_Port: type port V2G_UDP_SDP_Port message { out octetstring; in octetstring; }

common_errors.fix: The port instance name must be pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_{SUT}_Port (with _ALM_). The bare type is V2G_TCP_TLS_Port.

patterns.description: Verdict logic for GoodCase tests (valid input, expect success).
preconditions: test_type = GoodCase in generation_plan
SeqNo = 001

common_errors.fix: Timeout should be setverdict(inconc) in GoodCase -- inconclusive, not failed.

patterns.description: Verdict logic for BadCase tests (invalid input, expect rejection/timeout/close).
preconditions: test_type = BadCase in generation_plan
SeqNo >= 002

common_errors.error: setverdict(pass) on valid response in BadCase
common_errors.fix: BadCase expects rejection/timeout. If valid response arrives, it should be setverdict(fail).

patterns.description: How precondition chain position determines behavior. Position in the chain maps to protocol phase.
preconditions: None

position_1.behavior: SDP discovery via UDP multicast + TCP port mapping (f_{SUT}_CMN_PR_InitConfiguration_001)

position_3_to_n_minus_1.behavior: Subsequent V2G message exchanges (SessionSetup, ServiceDiscovery, etc.)

position_n.behavior: Sends the message under test, expects response in alt block (f_{SUT}_{Category}_TB_VTB_{MsgType}_{SeqNo})

patterns.description: CORRECT test behavior function using structured union templates. MUST end with 'return getverdict;' regardless of verdict outcome.
preconditions: Function must have return type verdicttype
For V2G application messages: use structured union templates

common_errors.error: Missing return getverdict at end of test behavior function
common_errors.fix: Always end with 'return getverdict;' so the testcase can capture and propagate the verdict.

common_errors.error: Using raw octetstring send on TCP port for V2G application messages
common_errors.fix: Use structured union: pt_V2G_TCP_TLS_ALM_SECC_Port.send({ msgType := md_CMN_MsgReq_001 })

patterns.description: Generic precondition function for V2G application messages (position 2+ in the precondition chain). Use structured union templates for send/receive.
preconditions: Position >= 2 in precondition_chain
Message-specific implementation required

patterns.description: PostConditions MUST run regardless of preConVerdict value. Phase D is unconditional.
preconditions: Phase D runs after Phase C verdict is set

common_errors.fix: PostConditions must be called unconditionally after Phase C, regardless of whether preconditions passed.

patterns.description: TTCN-3 does NOT re-export symbols imported through intermediate modules. The main testcase module MUST directly import from EVERY individual function module it calls. Do NOT rely solely on the aggregator module for imports.
preconditions: None

common_errors.error: Only importing aggregator modules, not individual function modules
common_errors.fix: TITAN does not re-export symbols through aggregator modules. Always add direct import from every function module called.

patterns_extracted: V2G message send via V2G_PortMessage v2g variant (CORRECT for V2G app messages)
V2GTP Header BadCase via V2G_PortMessage raw variant (ONLY exception for TCP port)
patterns_removed: V2GTP_Header_Construction (REMOVED -- teaches wrong approach: manual V2GTP construction with int2oct, violates core constraints)
Test_Behavior_Function_Return (REMOVED -- same reason, teaches raw V2GTP header)
Generic_Precondition_Stub (REMOVED -- same reason, teaches raw octetstrings on TCP)
